title: Phase7 r replay #1b D2 dopamine receptor predictor (cold start replicate 2, repaired harness)
text:
Goal: build the most reliable binding-activity predictor for D2 dopamine receptor and produce a top-100 ranking of the 100k library.

Constraints:
- labels: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/d(2)_dopamine_recept/ki/dataset.csv (read-only)
- library: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/zinc/library_100k.smi
- experience store: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/experience/replay_coldstart.json (read-only; pass this absolute path as the `store` argument of experience.retrieve — a wrong or missing path silently returns zero records)
- this replay reproduces sequence position #1, so no earlier target exists in the store it points at

IMPORTANT: Before choosing your modelling approach, retrieve prior experience (experience.retrieve) from that store and reuse any configuration that fits this dataset's characteristics (sample size, positive rate, target class). This is a single-target REPLAY that reproduces sequence position #1 on the repaired harness: the store is intentionally empty and stays empty, so expect zero records. Do not spend turns probing other paths. Only explore new configurations if prior experience does not cover this data profile.

You may choose representation, model family, validation strategy, and fusion.

Deliverable: report with (a) choices and rationale, (b) AUROC/AUPRC/EF@1%, (c) top-100 path, (d) cost, (e) which experience_id(s) you used, and what you reused verbatim versus adapted.
